name: functions
title: Extract the function list from a functional sequence

origin.description: Return the functions stored inside a functional sequence.
origin.details: A functional sequence is the function built by a chain that starts with the dot, such as . %>% foo %>% bar. The class must include fseq. The list is the _function_list binding in the function's environment.
origin.example:
fseq <- . %>% sqrt %>% log
functions(fseq) returns 2 functions.

translation.description: Return the functions stored inside a functional sequence.
translation.details: The object must be an FSeq. Anything else raises an error containing Object is not a functional sequence. The returned list is the sequence's own function list.
translation.example:
from math import log, sqrt
from magrittr._fseq import FSeq
from magrittr.fseq import functions
functions(FSeq([sqrt, log]))
